_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang unchanged at its tagged 0.43.0. beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.59.0, which adds canvas-mode hover column spotlighting in the Results grid, order-chip direction editing (Asc/Desc), and a fix for the Results grid's right-click Filter scoping to the wrong table in a join.
